glasgow_science_explainer.text: Welcome to Glasgow Science Centre, on the Clyde at Pacific Quay. It opened in 2001. Touch absolutely everything.
The Glasgow Tower outside is 127 metres tall and can turn right round to face the wind. It is the tallest fully rotating freestanding tower in the world.
Inside there is a planetarium, an IMAX cinema and a lot of buttons. Pressing them is the whole point.

glasgow_science_dad.text: My bairn dragged me here for the planetarium. I came out knowing the names of five stars, and one of them was the Sun.
